visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a person's lower leg and foot on a grey asphalt surface during bright daylight. The person is pulling up a navy blue sock that features a caricature of Donald Trump's face, uniquely adorned with a tuft of fuzzy, light-colored artificial hair to simulate his hairstyle. The word 'TRUMP' is printed vertically in bold letters on the sock. The individual is wearing a dark brown, polished leather loafer, and the background shows a slightly blurred pavement. (2) The visual transitions into a three-way horizontal split-screen montage. The top panel depicts a woman in a blonde wig, navy blue blazer, white shirt, and red tie, wearing 'deal with it' pixelated sunglasses while dancing outdoors. The middle panel shows a archival clip of the real Donald Trump reacting to someone patting his head. The bottom panel captures the person's feet in the caricature socks performing rhythmic steps on the asphalt. (3) The screen returns to a single, full-frame view of the woman in the Trump-inspired costume. She is holding a small American flag in her right hand and dancing energetically toward the camera. Behind her, a vibrant green Kawasaki-style sportbike and a white police interceptor vehicle are parked in a sunlit lot. She wears blue shorts that match her blazer, and her movements are synchronized with the musical beat, casting a clear shadow on the ground.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a sharp, percussive electronic hit SFX that emphasizes the visual movement of the sock. A high-tempo electronic dance beat begins immediately at 125 BPM, featuring a bright synthesizer texture and a heavy, four-on-the-floor kick drum. The mix is studio-clean with no audible background ambient noise, providing a high-arousal energy. (2) Energetic male group vocals enter the mix, singing the iconic 'Y.M.C.A.' chorus in a major key harmony. The vocals are loud and clear, layered over a driving disco-influenced electronic beat. The production quality is highly compressed and consistent with social media meme audio, maintaining a peak-level intensity and festive atmosphere throughout the transition. (3) The song continues without interruption, maintaining its fast tempo and bright spectral weight. Synthesized brass hits punctuate the rhythm, complementing the rhythmic vocal delivery of the male singers. The audio remains at a constant high volume with no dynamic fluctuation, ending with the ongoing high-energy dance loop and the repeating chorus motifs.
